summary: Join our Human-Centered Service Design Thinking Training to master innovative techniques for designing services that truly resonate with users and stakeholders.
lede: Human-Centered Service Design Thinking helps you redesign services around real human needs instead of leaving the user experience to chance. You will learn to see services through users’ eyes, understand what they experience before, during, and after interaction, and reduce friction across customer, citizen, or internal user journeys. This practical training shows you how to map end-to-end journeys, uncover root causes of pain points, generate and test ideas with low-risk prototypes, and use service blueprints to align people, processes, and technology. The result is a disciplined way to create service experiences that feel intuitive, respectful, valuable, inclusive, and efficient.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly design, deliver, manage, or improve services. It is ideal for those involved in customer-facing or citizen-facing services and those who aim to enhance service delivery and user satisfaction.
audience: Product or service owners in financial, telecom
Process improvement professionals (Lean, Six Sigma, BPM)
modules: Foundations of Human-Centered Service Design Thinking
Mapping User Journeys and Service Ecosystems
Service Blueprinting: Aligning Frontstage and Backstage
Embedding a Human-Centered Service Design Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of service delivery processes and a willingness to engage in collaborative, hands-on activities. No prior design experience is required, but openness to creative problem-solving is essential.
